role: The command-line engine that installs, configures and manages game server instances.

fields.label: Default library
fields.description: The library a new instance is placed in when the install names none. Empty uses the only registered library, and an install is refused when several exist and none is chosen.

fields.label: Install free-space margin
fields.description: Free space an install requires beyond the game's declared disk footprint before it proceeds.

fields.label: Instance id suffix length
fields.description: How many characters the random suffix of a generated instance id has.

fields.label: Save command timeout
fields.description: How long a backup or stop waits after sending a game its save command. Copied into a new instance.

fields.label: Stop command timeout
fields.description: How long a stop waits for the game to exit after its stop command before it escalates. Copied into a new instance.

fields.label: Update before start
fields.description: Whether a new instance checks for and applies a game update every time it starts.

fields.label: Maintenance windows
fields.description: Maintenance windows a new instance starts with, written schedule then tasks, for example daily@05:00/backup. Empty means no maintenance.

fields.label: Announcement lead times
fields.description: Minutes before a disruptive maintenance window at which a new instance tells its players, for example 15,5,1. Empty announces nothing.

fields.label: Announcement message
fields.description: What each lead-time announcement says. The words {minutes}, {reason} and {instance} are replaced.

fields.label: Cancellation message
fields.description: What players are told when an announced maintenance window is abandoned.

fields.label: Manage firewall
fields.description: Whether a new instance has its host firewall rules opened and closed with it.

fields.label: Forward ports
fields.description: Whether a new instance has its ports forwarded on the router while it runs.

fields.label: Backups directory
fields.description: Directory every instance's backups are kept under. Empty uses the engine's data directory. Existing instances keep the directory they were installed with.

fields.label: Compress backups
fields.description: Whether new backups are compressed archives rather than plain copies.

fields.label: Journal directory
fields.description: Directory the engine's event journal is written to. Readers find the journal here.

fields.label: Journal retention
fields.description: How many days of event journal are kept. Zero keeps everything.

fields.label: Cgroup v2 mount point
fields.description: Where the cgroup v2 hierarchy is mounted.

fields.label: Watchdog cgroup
fields.description: The watchdog's cgroup below the mount point. An instance's cgroup path is derived from it.

fields.label: Watchdog socket
fields.description: Unix socket the engine reaches the watchdog on to start and stop native instances.

fields.label: Use the watchdog
fields.description: Whether starts and stops of native instances go through the watchdog. Off starts them unsupervised.

fields.label: Firewall client
fields.description: The firewall client the engine runs to open and close an instance's ports.

fields.label: Firewall socket
fields.description: Unix socket of the firewall authority.

fields.label: Download timeout
fields.description: How long a game file download waits on a stalled connection before it gives up.

fields.label: Log level
fields.description: Minimum severity the engine writes to its log file.

fields.label: Log rotation size
fields.description: Size at which the engine's log file is rotated.

fields.label: Rotated log files
fields.description: How many rotated log files are kept beside the current one. Zero keeps none.
